ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (>90% dark) with isolated high-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the trailing edge and scattered across the central surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-grey/black pigmentation across the entire visible surface. High-contrast white focal spots are scattered sparsely across both lobes. A distinct non-geometric cluster of reddish-pink pixels is localized on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is moderate, creating a clear division between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the distal tips of both lobes, reaching 10-20 pixels in height relative to the base curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to an acute convex upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark background, most prominent on the right lobe and central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several thin, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the base pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including circular white pitting and multiple linear rake marks; a localized reddish-pink lesion/pigmentation patch is visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The reddish-pink pigmentation patch on the left lobe represents a highly unique visual marker distinct from standard black/white fluke patterns.
